decisions.reason: As a 2023 laser workstation that extends the core portfolio, it has already absorbed development and launch resources, and despite only modest website visibility, management is likely to keep it because weak traction can still be framed as normal market ramp-up.

The thermal inkjet printer is close to the established offer and has had its own page in both years, so the firm has made a visible commitment and is likely to persist rather than reverse course quickly.
This piezo inkjet printer also sits near the firm’s core technology base and has been publicly maintained on its own page, which makes withdrawal less likely under an escalation-of-commitment logic.
Industrial laser marking systems are central to the stated move toward production-wide identification and were shown on the home page, so management is especially likely to continue backing them.
The compact laser marking cabin was explicitly launched as new in 2024 and fits the existing laser-marking line, making it hard for management to abandon so soon after a public introduction.

Although more specialized, the lubricant printing system uses the firm’s high-resolution printing capabilities and its trade-fair award gives management a strong public justification to keep supporting it.
